findings.summary: `line run` now calls wf_resume at startup, so a BROKEN or blocked folder raises SystemExit before any terminal.json is written -- the scheduler sees only a zero-progress launch with no recorded blockage -- and neither this refusal nor the WorkFolderError -> absent-field path has a test (tests/test_cli.py only checks argument parsing).

WorkFolder.resume raises on overall == BROKEN, so a running line's envelope can never carry `resume_verification.overall == "BROKEN"`; the N7 negative branch is reachable only by injecting facts directly into LineConfig (as the test does), and a genuine mid-generation breakage self-reported by the coordinator is invalidated every round until the noop breaker converts it into a generic streak-blocked terminal that drops the coordinator's reason.

The guard's token match uppercases the whole reason, so a legitimate blocked verdict that mentions an unrelated breakage next to a verification/恢复/验证 word (e.g. "the database is broken, verification needs a ruling") is rejected as invalid and delayed by up to noop_limit rounds; this is the accepted cost of the spec-mandated mechanical comparison, not a deviation from it.

The committed implement handoff records work_head_commit 73835190d8d1458c2624e45679979adf8072304f while the dispatch context names 0d053f46e047f608567d46be680814ddcb5313c6, so the attached verification_record (uv sync --frozen, make verify, both exit 0) attests a commit other than the one named as this attempt's product head; this is a metadata-provenance inconsistency, not a product-tree defect.
